findings.name: Support for CDI
findings.claim: CDI generate since **v1.12.0**. From **v1.18.0**: `nvidia-cdi-refresh` writes `/var/run/cdi/nvidia.yaml` on toolkit/driver install/upgrade and reboot. Knobs: `nvidia-ctk cdi list`; manual `nvidia-ctk cdi generate --output=/var/run/cdi/nvidia.yaml`; env overrides in `/etc/nvidia-container-toolkit/nvidia-cdi-refresh.env`. **Known limits:** refresh does **not** handle driver removal or **MIG reconfiguration** — regenerate manually. Devices: `nvidia.com/gpu=all`, `=0`, MIG e.g. `nvidia.com/gpu=1:0`. JIT-CDI + `--disable-hook`.
